title: Jobs too big to share a resource
heading: A Cover Row Cuts Off LP Points the Budget Row Allows
cases: the jobs that each use more than half of a resource get one row allowing at most one of them, which lowers the LP bound and keeps every whole plan
every resource gives its own row over its own big jobs
two jobs using exactly half a resource each fit together, so no row may forbid that pair
a job using more than all of a resource is held at 0, so the LP cannot fund part of it
